key_insight: Predicting time increments with a Fourier Neural Operator improves Rayleigh-Bénard convection forecasting accuracy over a standard full-solution FNO.
engineering_relevance: The model offers a compact, fast CFD surrogate that can accelerate reduced-order simulation workflows while preserving benchmark-level accuracy.
method: Use an improved FNO architecture tailored to 2D Rayleigh-Bénard convection.
Predict temporal increments rather than the full state at each step.
Compare against a standard FNO baseline on the same benchmark task.
evidence_signal: The model is reported to achieve 314k parameters, 1.26 MB size, and 7 ms inference, with accuracy comparable to prior benchmark results.
watch_item: Generalization to finer meshes is possible, but final accuracy is still limited by the resolution of the training data.
paper_title: Fourier Neural Operators for Rayleigh-Bénard Convection
